info.prompt: Neo-gothic hacker sanctum, the charge meter a jagged spine of gold and obsidian along the vaulted ceiling, its segments filling with liquid neon for every 100 points banked—Farkles trigger hydraulic hisses and amber warning flares as the meter violently contracts, while the ultimate roll unfolds in slow-motion, the dice emitting a low-frequency hum as they hover within a hexagonal forcefield of crackling neural lattice, the background alive with pulsating void-black and scrolling terminal code that whispers encrypted alchemical formulae.
